duas.title: SubhanAllah
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
duas.translit: SubhanAllah
duas.meaning: Glory be to Allah.
duas.source: Sahih Muslim 597 (33 times after each prayer)

duas.title: Alhamdulillah
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
duas.translit: Alhamdulillah
duas.meaning: All praise is for Allah.
duas.source: Sahih Muslim 597 (33 times after each prayer)

duas.title: Allahu Akbar
duas.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
duas.translit: Allahu Akbar
duas.meaning: Allah is the Greatest.
duas.source: Sahih Muslim 597 (33 times after each prayer)

duas.title: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu
duas.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.translit: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir
duas.meaning: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is over all things competent.
duas.source: Sahih al-Bukhari 6403; Sahih Muslim 2691 (100 times a day)

duas.title: La ilaha illallah
duas.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ
duas.translit: La ilaha illallah
duas.meaning: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah.

duas.title: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
duas.translit: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi
duas.meaning: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him.
duas.source: Sahih al-Bukhari 6405; Sahih Muslim 2691 (100 times a day — sins forgiven)

duas.title: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi, SubhanAllahil-'Azim
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
duas.translit: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi, SubhanAllahil-'Azim
duas.meaning: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him; glory be to Allah, the Most Great.
duas.source: Sahih al-Bukhari 6682 (light on the tongue, heavy on the scale)

duas.title: SubhanAllah, Alhamdulillah, La ilaha illallah, Allahu Akbar
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
duas.translit: SubhanAllah, walhamdulillah, wa la ilaha illallah, wallahu akbar
duas.meaning: Glory be to Allah, all praise is for Allah, none has the right to be worshipped but Allah, and Allah is the Greatest.
duas.source: Sahih Muslim 2137 (the words most beloved to Allah)

duas.title: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
duas.arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
duas.translit: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
duas.meaning: There is no might and no power except with Allah.

duas.title: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi 'adada khalqihi
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
duas.translit: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi, 'adada khalqihi, wa rida nafsihi, wa zinata 'arshihi, wa midada kalimatihi
duas.meaning: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him, as many as His creation, as much as pleases Him, as heavy as His Throne, and as much as the ink of His words.
duas.source: Sahih Muslim 2726 (3 times, in the morning)

duas.title: Salawat on the Prophet ﷺ
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
duas.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Muhammad
duas.meaning: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad.
duas.source: Sahih Muslim 408 (one blessing brings ten from Allah)

duas.title: Astaghfirullah
duas.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ
duas.translit: Astaghfirullah
duas.meaning: I seek Allah's forgiveness.
duas.source: Sahih Muslim 2702 (the Prophet ﷺ sought forgiveness 100 times a day)

duas.title: Astaghfirullah wa atubu ilayh
duas.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
duas.translit: Astaghfirullaha wa atubu ilayh
duas.meaning: I seek Allah's forgiveness and turn to Him in repentance.

duas.title: Sayyid al-Istighfar
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَىٰ عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
duas.translit: Allahumma anta Rabbi la ilaha illa ant, khalaqtani wa ana 'abduk, wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata't, a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana't, abu'u laka bini'matika 'alayya, wa abu'u bidhanbi faghfir li, fa innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant
duas.meaning: O Allah, You are my Lord; none has the right to be worshipped but You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I keep Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil I have done. I acknowledge Your favour upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins but You.
duas.source: Sahih al-Bukhari 6306 (the master of seeking forgiveness — morning and evening)

duas.title: Allahumma innaka 'afuwwun
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
duas.translit: Allahumma innaka 'afuwwun tuhibbul-'afwa fa'fu 'anni
duas.meaning: O Allah, You are Pardoning and love to pardon, so pardon me.

duas.title: Dua of Yunus (Dhun-Nun)
duas.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
duas.translit: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin
duas.meaning: There is no god but You; glory be to You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.

duas.title: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
duas.translit: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma'as-mihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i wa huwas-Sami'ul-'Alim
duas.meaning: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in the heavens can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
duas.source: Sunan Abi Dawud 5088; Jami' at-Tirmidhi 3388 (3 times morning and evening)

duas.title: Raditu billahi Rabba
duas.arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ نَبِيًّا
duas.translit: Raditu billahi Rabba, wa bil-Islami dina, wa bi-Muhammadin ﷺ nabiyya
duas.meaning: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad ﷺ as my Prophet.
duas.source: Sunan Abi Dawud 5072 (3 times morning and evening)

duas.title: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa huwa
duas.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
duas.translit: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa huwa, 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa huwa Rabbul-'Arshil-'Azim
duas.meaning: Allah is sufficient for me; there is no god but Him. In Him I put my trust, and He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne.
duas.source: Quran 9:129; Sunan Abi Dawud 5081 (7 times morning and evening)

duas.title: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammat
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
duas.translit: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq
duas.meaning: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
duas.source: Sahih Muslim 2708, 2709 (evening, and when stopping at a place)

duas.title: Asking for well-being ('Afiyah)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
duas.translit: Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afwa wal-'afiyata fid-dunya wal-akhirah
duas.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this world and the Hereafter.

duas.title: Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal-wakil
duas.arabic: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
duas.translit: Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal-wakil
duas.meaning: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best disposer of affairs.

duas.title: Ya Muqallibal-qulub
duas.arabic: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَىٰ دِينِكَ
duas.translit: Ya Muqallibal-qulub, thabbit qalbi 'ala dinik
duas.meaning: O Turner of hearts, keep my heart firm upon Your religion.

duas.title: Allahumma a'inni 'ala dhikrik
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَىٰ ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
duas.translit: Allahumma a'inni 'ala dhikrika wa shukrika wa husni 'ibadatik
duas.meaning: O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You in the best way.

duas.title: Refuge from worry and grief
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
duas.translit: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wal-'ajzi wal-kasal, wal-bukhli wal-jubn, wa dala'id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijal
duas.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, from weakness and laziness, from miserliness and cowardice, and from the burden of debt and being overpowered by men.

duas.title: Dua in distress
duas.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
duas.translit: La ilaha illallahul-'Azimul-Halim, la ilaha illallahu Rabbul-'Arshil-'Azim, la ilaha illallahu Rabbus-samawati wa Rabbul-ardi wa Rabbul-'Arshil-Karim
duas.meaning: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, the Mighty, the Forbearing. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, Lord of the Mighty Throne. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth and Lord of the Noble Throne.

duas.title: Rabbi ishrah li sadri
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي
duas.translit: Rabbish-rah li sadri wa yassir li amri
duas.meaning: My Lord, expand for me my chest and ease for me my task.

duas.title: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanah
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.translit: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina 'adhaban-nar
duas.meaning: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

duas.title: Rabbi zidni 'ilma
duas.arabic: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
duas.translit: Rabbi zidni 'ilma
duas.meaning: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

duas.title: Rabbana zalamna anfusana
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنْفُسَنَا وَإِنْ لَمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
duas.translit: Rabbana zalamna anfusana wa in lam taghfir lana wa tarhamna lanakunanna minal-khasirin
duas.meaning: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.

duas.title: Rabbana hab lana min azwajina
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
duas.translit: Rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa dhurriyyatina qurrata a'yunin waj'alna lil-muttaqina imama
duas.meaning: Our Lord, grant us from our spouses and offspring comfort to our eyes, and make us leaders of the righteous.

duas.title: Rabbana la tuzigh qulubana
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ
duas.translit: Rabbana la tuzigh qulubana ba'da idh hadaytana wa hab lana min ladunka rahmah, innaka antal-Wahhab
duas.meaning: Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us, and grant us mercy from Yourself. Indeed, You are the Bestower.

duas.title: Dua for parents
duas.arabic: رَبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
duas.translit: Rabbir-hamhuma kama rabbayani saghira
duas.meaning: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up when I was small.

duas.title: Ayat al-Kursi
duas.arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
duas.translit: Allahu la ilaha illa huwal-Hayyul-Qayyum, la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm, lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard, man dhal-ladhi yashfa'u 'indahu illa bi-idhnih, ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum, wa la yuhituna bishay'im-min 'ilmihi illa bima sha', wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samawati wal-ard, wa la ya'uduhu hifzuhuma, wa huwal-'Aliyyul-'Azim
duas.meaning: Allah — there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what will be after them, and they encompass nothing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
duas.source: Quran 2:255 · after each prayer and before sleep (Sahih al-Bukhari 2311)

duas.title: Surah Al-Ikhlas
duas.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ۝ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ ۝ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ۝ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
duas.translit: Qul huwallahu ahad. Allahus-samad. Lam yalid wa lam yulad. Wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad.
duas.meaning: Say, "He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, nor is there to Him any equivalent."
duas.source: Quran 112 · 3 times morning, evening and before sleep (Sunan Abi Dawud 5082)

duas.title: Surah Al-Falaq
duas.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ۝ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ۝ وَمِنْ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ۝ وَمِنْ شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ ۝ وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
duas.translit: Qul a'udhu bi-rabbil-falaq. Min sharri ma khalaq. Wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqab. Wa min sharrin-naffathati fil-'uqad. Wa min sharri hasidin idha hasad.
duas.meaning: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, from the evil of what He created, from the evil of darkness when it settles, from the evil of those who blow on knots, and from the evil of an envier when he envies."
duas.source: Quran 113 · 3 times morning, evening and before sleep (Sunan Abi Dawud 5082)

duas.title: Surah An-Nas
duas.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ ۝ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ ۝ إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِنْ شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ ۝ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
duas.translit: Qul a'udhu bi-rabbin-nas. Malikin-nas. Ilahin-nas. Min sharril-waswasil-khannas. Alladhi yuwaswisu fi sudurin-nas. Minal-jinnati wan-nas.
duas.meaning: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the King of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the retreating whisperer, who whispers into the hearts of mankind, from among the jinn and mankind."
duas.source: Quran 114 · 3 times morning, evening and before sleep (Sunan Abi Dawud 5082)

duas.title: Before sleeping
duas.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
duas.translit: Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya
duas.meaning: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

duas.title: Upon waking up
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
duas.translit: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur
duas.meaning: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after causing us to die, and to Him is the return.

duas.title: Leaving the house
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
duas.translit: Bismillah, tawakkaltu 'alallah, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
duas.meaning: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no might and no power except with Allah.

duas.title: After eating
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَٰذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
duas.translit: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi at'amani hadha wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah
duas.meaning: All praise is for Allah who fed me this and provided it for me without any might or power from myself.

duas.title: Dua for travel
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ
duas.translit: Subhanal-ladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin, wa inna ila Rabbina lamunqalibun
duas.meaning: Glory be to Him who has subjected this to us, and we could never have done it ourselves. And to our Lord we will surely return.

duas.title: Entering the masjid
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
duas.translit: Allahummaf-tah li abwaba rahmatik
duas.meaning: O Allah, open for me the doors of Your mercy.

duas.title: Visiting the sick
duas.arabic: لَا بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
duas.translit: La ba'sa tahurun in sha' Allah
duas.meaning: No harm — it is a purification, if Allah wills.

duas.title: When it rains
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا
duas.translit: Allahumma sayyiban nafi'a
duas.meaning: O Allah, (make it) a beneficial rain.

names.title: 98. Ar-Rashid
names.meaning: The Guide to the Right Path
